Looking at the project structure and API routes, I'll create comprehensive HTTP test files covering all endpoints.

```http /home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior/plugins/simpleopd.ai/simplepod.ai.manager.http
### SimplePod.AI GPU Manager - REST API Tests
### Base URL: http://localhost:3000
### Copy .env.example to .env and set SIMPLEPOD_API_KEY before running

@baseUrl = http://localhost:3000
@contentType = application/json

# ─── Variables (update after creating resources) ──────────────────────────────
@instanceId = REPLACE_WITH_INSTANCE_ID
@templateId = REPLACE_WITH_TEMPLATE_ID


###############################################################################
# 🏥 HEALTH
###############################################################################

### Health Check
# @name health
GET {{baseUrl}}/health
Accept: {{contentType}}


###############################################################################
# 📋 TEMPLATES
###############################################################################

### [T-1] List all templates
# @name listTemplates
GET {{baseUrl}}/templates
Accept: {{contentType}}

###

### [T-2] Create a template — vLLM A100
# @name createTemplate
POST {{baseUrl}}/templates
Content-Type: {{contentType}}

{
  "name": "vLLM A100 OpenAI Server",
  "description": "vLLM server with OpenAI-compatible API on A100",
  "gpuType": "A100",
  "gpuCount": 1,
  "cpuCount": 8,
  "ramGb": 64,
  "diskGb": 200,
  "dockerImage": "vllm/vllm-openai:latest",
  "envVars": {
    "MODEL": "meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct",
    "MAX_MODEL_LEN": "8192"
  },
  "ports": [8000]
}

###

### [T-3] Create a template — H100 Stable Diffusion
# @name createTemplateSD
POST {{baseUrl}}/templates
Content-Type: {{contentType}}

{
  "name": "Stable Diffusion H100",
  "description": "High-throughput image generation server",
  "gpuType": "H100",
  "gpuCount": 2,
  "cpuCount": 16,
  "ramGb": 128,
  "diskGb": 500,
  "dockerImage": "stability-ai/stable-diffusion:latest",
  "envVars": {
    "PRECISION": "fp16"
  },
  "ports": [7860]
}

###

### [T-4] Create a template — RTX 4090 Dev Box
# @name createTemplateDev
POST {{baseUrl}}/templates
Content-Type: {{contentType}}

{
  "name": "RTX 4090 Dev Box",
  "description": "General purpose GPU dev environment",
  "gpuType": "RTX4090",
  "gpuCount": 1,
  "cpuCount": 4,
  "ramGb": 32,
  "diskGb": 100,
  "dockerImage": "pytorch/pytorch:2.3.0-cuda12.1-cudnn8-runtime",
  "ports": [8888, 6006]
}

###

### [T-5] Get template by ID
# @name getTemplate
GET {{baseUrl}}/templates/{{templateId}}
Accept: {{contentType}}

###

### [T-6] Update template — rename and add description
# @name updateTemplate
PATCH {{baseUrl}}/templates/{{templateId}}
Content-Type: {{contentType}}

{
  "name": "vLLM A100 OpenAI Server (updated)",
  "description": "Updated: vLLM with Llama 3.1 on A100 — 80GB VRAM"
}

###

### [T-7] Update template — change GPU count
PATCH {{baseUrl}}/templates/{{templateId}}
Content-Type: {{contentType}}

{
  "gpuCount": 2,
  "ramGb": 128
}

###

### [T-8] Delete template
# @name deleteTemplate
DELETE {{baseUrl}}/templates/{{templateId}}
Accept: {{contentType}}


###############################################################################
# 🖥️ INSTANCES
###############################################################################

### [I-1] List all instances
# @name listInstances
GET {{baseUrl}}/instances
Accept: {{contentType}}

###

### [I-2] Create instance — no TTL (manual shutdown)
# @name createInstance
POST {{baseUrl}}/instances
Content-Type: {{contentType}}

{
  "name": "my-llm-server",
  "templateId": "{{templateId}}"
}

###

### [I-3] Create instance — with 60-minute TTL
# @name createInstanceTTL
POST {{baseUrl}}/instances
Content-Type: {{contentType}}

{
  "name": "my-llm-server-ttl",
  "templateId": "{{templateId}}",
  "ttlMinutes": 60
}

###

### [I-4] Create instance — with 2-hour TTL
POST {{baseUrl}}/instances
Content-Type: {{contentType}}

{
  "name": "my-llm-server-2h",
  "templateId": "{{templateId}}",
  "ttlMinutes": 120
}

###

### [I-5] Get instance by ID
# @name getInstance
GET {{baseUrl}}/instances/{{instanceId}}
Accept: {{contentType}}

###

### [I-6] Update instance — rename
# @name updateInstance
PATCH {{baseUrl}}/instances/{{instanceId}}
Content-Type: {{contentType}}

{
  "name": "my-llm-server-renamed"
}

###

### [I-7] Update instance — set TTL to 30 minutes
PATCH {{baseUrl}}/instances/{{instanceId}}
Content-Type: {{contentType}}

{
  "ttlMinutes": 30
}

###

### [I-8] Start instance
# @name startInstance
POST {{baseUrl}}/instances/{{instanceId}}/start
Content-Type: {{contentType}}

###

### [I-9] Stop instance
# @name stopInstance
POST {{baseUrl}}/instances/{{instanceId}}/stop
Content-Type: {{contentType}}

###

### [I-10] Delete instance
# @name deleteInstance
DELETE {{baseUrl}}/instances/{{instanceId}}
Accept: {{contentType}}


###############################################################################
# ❌ VALIDATION ERRORS — Templates
###############################################################################

### [VT-1] Create template — missing required fields
POST {{baseUrl}}/templates
Content-Type: {{contentType}}

{
  "name": "Incomplete Template"
}

###

### [VT-2] Create template — invalid gpuCount (zero)
POST {{baseUrl}}/templates
Content-Type: {{contentType}}

{
  "name": "Bad GPU Count",
  "gpuType": "A100",
  "gpuCount": 0,
  "cpuCount": 4,
  "ramGb": 32,
  "diskGb": 100,
  "dockerImage": "some/image:latest"
}

###

### [VT-3] Create template — empty name
POST {{baseUrl}}/templates
Content-Type: {{contentType}}

{
  "name": "",
  "gpuType": "A100",
  "gpuCount": 1,
  "cpuCount": 4,
  "ramGb": 32,
  "diskGb": 100,
  "dockerImage": "some/image:latest"
}

###

### [VT-4] Get template — non-existent ID
GET {{baseUrl}}/templates/non-existent-id-000
Accept: {{contentType}}


###############################################################################
# ❌ VALIDATION ERRORS — Instances
###############################################################################

### [VI-1] Create instance — missing templateId
POST {{baseUrl}}/instances
Content-Type: {{contentType}}

{
  "name": "incomplete-instance"
}

###

### [VI-2] Create instance — negative TTL
POST {{baseUrl}}/instances
Content-Type: {{contentType}}

{
  "name": "bad-ttl-instance",
  "templateId": "{{templateId}}",
  "ttlMinutes": -10
}

###

### [VI-3] Create instance — empty name
POST {{baseUrl}}/instances
Content-Type: {{contentType}}

{
  "name": "",
  "templateId": "{{templateId}}"
}

###

### [VI-4] Get instance — non-existent ID
GET {{baseUrl}}/instances/non-existent-id-000
Accept: {{contentType}}

###

### [VI-5] Start instance — non-existent ID
POST {{baseUrl}}/instances/non-existent-id-000/start
Content-Type: {{contentType}}

###

### [VI-6] Stop instance — non-existent ID
POST {{baseUrl}}/instances/non-existent-id-000/stop
Content-Type: {{contentType}}


###############################################################################
# 🔀 PROXY — OpenAI-Compatible Requests
###############################################################################

### [P-1] List available models (GET)
# @name proxyModels
# Requires: instance running with OpenAI-compatible server (e.g. vLLM)
GET {{baseUrl}}/proxy/{{instanceId}}/v1/models
Accept: {{contentType}}

###

### [P-2] Chat completion — non-streaming
# @name proxyChatCompletion
POST {{baseUrl}}/proxy/{{instanceId}}/v1/chat/completions
Content-Type: {{contentType}}

{
  "model": "meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct",
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "system",
      "content": "You are a helpful assistant."
    },
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "What is a GPU and why is it useful for AI?"
    }
  ],
  "temperature": 0.7,
  "max_tokens": 512,
  "stream": false
}

###

### [P-3] Chat completion — streaming (SSE)
# @name proxyChatStream
POST {{baseUrl}}/proxy/{{instanceId}}/v1/chat/completions
Content-Type: {{contentType}}
Accept: text/event-stream

{
  "model": "meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct",
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "Write a short poem about GPUs."
    }
  ],
  "temperature": 0.9,
  "max_tokens": 256,
  "stream": true
}

###

### [P-4] Text completion (legacy)
# @name proxyCompletion
POST {{baseUrl}}/proxy/{{instanceId}}/v1/completions
Content-Type: {{contentType}}

{
  "model": "meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct",
  "prompt": "The future of AI infrastructure is",
  "max_tokens": 100,
  "temperature": 0.8,
  "stream": false
}

###

### [P-5] Embeddings
# @name proxyEmbeddings
POST {{baseUrl}}/proxy/{{instanceId}}/v1/embeddings
Content-Type: {{contentType}}

{
  "model": "text-embedding-ada-002",
  "input": "SimplePod GPU Manager makes renting GPUs effortless."
}

###

### [P-6] Proxy — instance not running (503 expected)
POST {{baseUrl}}/proxy/non-existent-id-000/v1/chat/completions
Content-Type: {{contentType}}

{
  "model": "llama",
  "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "test" }]
}


###############################################################################
# 🔄 WORKFLOWS — End-to-end sequences
###############################################################################

### [W-1] WORKFLOW STEP 1 — Create a template
# Run this first, then copy the returned ID to @templateId above
POST {{baseUrl}}/templates
Content-Type: {{contentType}}

{
  "name": "Workflow Test Template",
  "gpuType": "A100",
  "gpuCount": 1,
  "cpuCount": 8,
  "ramGb": 64,
  "diskGb": 200,
  "dockerImage": "vllm/vllm-openai:latest",
  "ports": [8000]
}

###

### [W-2] WORKFLOW STEP 2 — Create instance from template
# Copy template ID from W-1 response, set @templateId, then run this
# Copy returned instance ID to @instanceId above
POST {{baseUrl}}/instances
Content-Type: {{contentType}}

{
  "name": "workflow-test-instance",
  "templateId": "{{templateId}}",
  "ttlMinutes": 30
}

###

### [W-3] WORKFLOW STEP 3 — Verify instance is running
GET {{baseUrl}}/instances/{{instanceId}}
Accept: {{contentType}}

###

### [W-4] WORKFLOW STEP 4 — Run inference via proxy
POST {{baseUrl}}/proxy/{{instanceId}}/v1/chat/completions
Content-Type: {{contentType}}

{
  "model": "meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct",
  "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Hello from the workflow test!" }],
  "max_tokens": 64,
  "stream": false
}

###

### [W-5] WORKFLOW STEP 5 — Stop instance
POST {{baseUrl}}/instances/{{instanceId}}/stop
Content-Type: {{contentType}}

###

### [W-6] WORKFLOW STEP 6 — Delete instance
DELETE {{baseUrl}}/instances/{{instanceId}}
Accept: {{contentType}}

###

### [W-7] WORKFLOW STEP 7 — Delete template (cleanup)
DELETE {{baseUrl}}/templates/{{templateId}}
Accept: {{contentType}}
```

The HTTP test file covers:

| Section | Requests | Purpose |
|---------|----------|---------|
| 🏥 Health | 1 | Server liveness check |
| 📋 Templates | 8 | Full CRUD + edge cases |
| 🖥️ Instances | 9 | Full lifecycle management |
| ❌ Validation — Templates | 4 | Bad input / 404 errors |
| ❌ Validation — Instances | 6 | Bad input / missing resources |
| 🔀 Proxy | 6 | Models, chat, stream, embeddings, error |
| 🔄 Workflows | 7 | Full end-to-end create → infer → cleanup |

**Usage tips:**
- Works with **VSCode REST Client** extension or **JetBrains HTTP Client**
- Update `@instanceId` and `@templateId` variables after running the workflow create steps
- Run `W-1` through `W-7` in order for a complete end-to-end test
